q1_issues.issue: A distributive predicate on a definite/grouped plural is specified to keep the group event and ADD the per-member rule ('the dogs barked'; 'The kegs do not ferment' emits both), but only the per-member rule is emitted here, so no group-level burn event exists for counting / 'did any?' queries.
(Inheritance wintergloss gloss) asserts an IS-A that most likely fails for a coined substance name (the hot-dog / foxglove case), where the instruction set directs that the head genus be suppressed.

q2_gaps: a frequency adverb ('sometimes') on a DEFINITE-PLURAL habitual: the dial sets the strength of a rule or a flat generic, but nothing says whether the group-event half of the group-event + per-member-rule pair is still emitted, or which of the two atoms carries the reduced (0.5) strength
notes: The 0.5 strength for 'sometimes', the QuantifierPhrase companion naming the group's member kind, Patient for burn, the bare-kind wintergloss object, Location for 'at', and the one-opaque-symbol name with its 'Lantern' type atom all conform. Treating 'the Keepers' as a definite plural (GroupOf) rather than a capitalized-plural Name-only individual is the right call, since 'Keeper' reads as a role kind rather than a proper label.
